about: Replies of the GUI backend at the start of P27 B6 (Composer run as a command, Ursatz-GUI main a2082ae) to the requests below, captured before the routes moved to the Composer API. Placeholders: @project is a project id, @source and @target are saved motifs (source_notes, target_notes) in C minor. A refusal is compared by status only (its text came from the command's stderr); the status case is compared on the members it had.
